## Define Gene Sets
### Positive Negative 
```{r}
# Poon NI 2023
xl <- read.xlsx("../data/TRM_Sig/Poonetal_SuppTable7_barrTRM_v_Other_DEGs.xlsx", sheet = 1)
xl <- xl[-1] 
xl_up <- xl %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = c("Tissue", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(JE|LG|SK)_(.*)"
  ) %>% subset(logfoldchang > 0.75 & pvals_adj < 0.05) %>%
  group_by(names) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(n_distinct(Tissue) >= 3) %>%
  ungroup()  

xl_up <- unique(xl_up$names)
xl_up <- paste0(xl_up, "+")

xl_down <- xl %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = c("Tissue", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(JE|LG|SK)_(.*)"
  ) %>% subset(logfoldchang < -0.75 & pvals_adj <0.05) %>%
  group_by(names) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(n_distinct(Tissue) >= 3) %>%
  ungroup()  
# The data have been subset to include significant genes only present in 2 or more organs

xl_down <- unique(xl_down$names)
xl_down <- paste0(xl_down, "-")
Poon_2023 <- c(xl_up, xl_down)

# Mackay 2016
Mackay_2016 <- read.xlsx("../data/TRM_Sig/Trm_sig_Mackay2016_suppFig13.xlsx", sheet = 1)
Mackay_2016 <- as.vector(na.omit(convert_mouse_to_human_symbols(Mackay_2016$Gene)))

# Scott 2025 - Genes_Up
Scott_2025_Icos <- read.xlsx("../data/TRM_Sig/Trm_signature_Scott2025_Figure7.xlsx", sheet = 1)
Scott_2025_NoIcos <- read.xlsx("../data/TRM_Sig/Trm_signature_Scott2025_Figure7.xlsx", sheet = 3)
Scott_2025_up <- unique(c(Scott_2025_Icos$Icoshi_Trm_up_genes, Scott_2025_NoIcos$Icoslo_Trm_up_genes))
Scott_2025_up <- paste0(as.vector(na.omit(convert_mouse_to_human_symbols(Scott_2025_up))), "+")

# Scott 2025 - Genes_Down

Scott_2025_NoIcos <- read.xlsx("../data/TRM_Sig/Trm_signature_Scott2025_Figure7.xlsx", sheet = 4)
Scott_2025_down <- unique(c(Scott_2025_Icos$Icoshi_Trm_down_genes, Scott_2025_NoIcos$Icoslo_Trm_down_genes))
Scott_2025_down <- paste0(as.vector(na.omit(convert_mouse_to_human_symbols(Scott_2025_down))), "-")
Scott_2025 <- c(Scott_2025_up, Scott_2025_down)

# Jaiswal

up <- na.omit(up)
```

#----SCENIC DEG Identifies TRM related GRNs----
## DEG
```{r}
Idents(Tc_8) <- "Tissue"

AUC_Unstable <- FindMarkers(Tc_8, assay="AUC", slot = "scale.data",
      logfc.threshold = 0.2,
      ident.1 = "Unstable",
      ident.2 = "Blood",
      test.use = "MAST",
      only.pos = F)

AUC_Unstable <- subset(AUC_Unstable, p_val_adj < 0.05)

AUC_Stable <- FindMarkers(Tc_8, assay="AUC", slot = "scale.data",
      logfc.threshold = 0.2,
      ident.1 = "Stable",
      ident.2 = "Blood",
      test.use = "MAST",
      only.pos = F)

AUC_Stable <- subset(AUC_Stable, p_val_adj < 0.05)

## 1. Up-regulated (avg_log2FC > 0.25 in BOTH comparisons)
up_unstable <- subset(AUC_Unstable, avg_log2FC > 0 & p_val_adj < 0.05)
up_stable   <- subset(AUC_Stable,   avg_log2FC > 0 & p_val_adj < 0.05)

common_up_genes <- intersect(rownames(up_unstable), rownames(up_stable))

common_up <- data.frame(
  gene            = common_up_genes,
  logFC_Unstable  = AUC_Unstable[common_up_genes, "avg_log2FC"],
  logFC_Stable    = AUC_Stable[common_up_genes,   "avg_log2FC"],
  group = "up"
)

## 2. Down-regulated (avg_log2FC < -0.25 in BOTH comparisons)
down_unstable <- subset(AUC_Unstable, avg_log2FC < 0 & p_val_adj < 0.05)
down_stable   <- subset(AUC_Stable,   avg_log2FC < 0 & p_val_adj < 0.05)

common_down_genes <- intersect(rownames(down_unstable), rownames(down_stable))

common_down <- data.frame(
  gene            = common_down_genes,
  logFC_Unstable  = AUC_Unstable[common_down_genes, "avg_log2FC"],
  logFC_Stable    = AUC_Stable[common_down_genes,   "avg_log2FC"],
  group = "down"
)

AUC <- rbind(common_up, common_down)
AUC$gene_name <- gsub("\\(\\+\\)", "", AUC$gene)

established_upregulons <- intersect(AUC$gene_name, genes_2plus)
established_upregulons


```

#----What cells are TRM----
```{r}
DefaultAssay(Tc_8) <- "RNA"
#Assign quartile ratings
q <- quantile(Tc_8$TRM_Avg_UCell, probs = c(0.25, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)

# Create a new metadata column with TRMhi / TRMint / TRMlo classification
Tc_8$TRM_group <- cut(
  Tc_8$TRM_Avg_UCell,
  breaks = c(-Inf, q[1], q[2], Inf),
  labels = c("TRMlo", "TRMint", "TRMhi"),
  include.lowest = TRUE
)
```

#----What drives TRM signature? - General----
```{r}
p8 <- subset(Tc_8, PB == "Plaque")

  # subset to this celltype and keep only TRMhi / TRMlo
  sub <- subset(
    p8,
    subset = TRM_group %in% c("TRMhi", "TRMlo"))

  Idents(sub) <- "TRM_group"

  res <- FindAllMarkers(sub, assay="RNA",
      logfc.threshold = 0.25,
      min.pct = 0.25,
      test.use = "MAST",
      only.pos = F)

  res <- res[res$p_val_adj < 0.05, ]
```

## Identification of signature genes vs. non-signature genes
```{r}
sig_genes <- res[res$gene %in% genes_2plus, ]
missing_genes <- setdiff(genes_2plus, res$gene)
missing_genes_df <- data.frame(gene = missing_genes)

sig_genes_absent <- subset(genes_2plus, !(genes_2plus %in% res$gene))
NOTsig_genes <- res[!c(res$gene %in% genes_2plus), ]
down <- subset(res, cluster == "TRMlo" & avg_log2FC >0.25)
```

```{r}
features_up_signature <- c("NR4A1", "JUNB", "FOS", "NR4A3", "JUN", "KLF6", "NR4A2","CD69", "BHLHE40", "ALDOA")
features_up_notsig <- c("FOSB", "LMNA", "RGCC", "TNFSF9", "CXCR4", "MCL1", "VIM", "TGFB1", "GPX4", "ATF3", "AREG", "GATA3", "TFRC")
features_down <- c("TXNIP", "KLRG1", "ITGB1", "ITGAL", "ITGA4", "ZAP70", "CCL5", "S1PR1", "FGFBP2")

genes <- c(features_up_notsig, features_up_signature, features_down)


# --- Subset to genes of interest ---
df <- res[res$gene %in% genes, ]

mat <- acast(
  df, cluster ~ gene,
  value.var = "avg_log2FC",
  fun.aggregate = mean, na.rm = TRUE
)


stopifnot("TRMhi" %in% rownames(mat), "TRMlo" %in% rownames(mat))
trmhi <- mat["TRMhi", ]

TRM_up_notsig_ordered    <- names(sort(trmhi[features_up_notsig],    decreasing = TRUE))
TRM_up_signature_ordered <- names(sort(trmhi[features_up_signature], decreasing = TRUE))
TRM_down_ordered         <- names(sort(trmhi[features_down],         decreasing = FALSE))  # most negative first

# --- Final order (Signature Up → Other Up → Down) ---
genes_ordered <- c(TRM_up_notsig_ordered, TRM_up_signature_ordered, TRM_down_ordered)
genes_ordered <- genes_ordered[genes_ordered %in% colnames(mat)]  # drop any missing safely

# --- Reindex matrix columns ---
mat <- mat[c("TRMhi", "TRMlo"), genes_ordered, drop = FALSE]

group_levels <- c("putative", "established", "down")

col_groups <- dplyr::case_when(
  genes_ordered %in% features_up_notsig    ~ "putative",
  genes_ordered %in% features_up_signature ~ "established",
  genes_ordered %in% features_down         ~ "down",
  TRUE                                     ~ NA_character_
)

col_groups <- factor(col_groups, levels = group_levels)


column_titles <- c(
  expression(
  atop(
    "Putative Plaque", T[RM] * " Genes")),
  expression(
  atop(
    "Established", T[RM] * " Genes")),
  expression(
  atop(
    "Genes down in", T[RM] * "-hi")))

# --- Colours ---
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-1.5, 0, 1.5), c("blue", "white", "red"))

row_labels <- c(
  expression(T[RM]-hi),
  expression(T[RM]-lo)
)

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat,
  height = nrow(mat) * unit(5, "mm"),
  width  = ncol(mat) * unit(5, "mm"),
  name   = "avg_log2FC",
  col    = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  column_title = column_titles,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_labels = row_labels,
  row_names_side = "left",
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_split = col_groups,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = txt_pt, rot = 45),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = txt_pt, rot = 45),
  column_title_gp =  gpar(fontsize = txt_pt),
  border = TRUE,
  show_column_dend = FALSE,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Expression",
    direction = "horizontal",
    position = "center",
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = txt_pt),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = txt_pt, rot = 0)
  )
)

svglite("../docs/assets/04-Figure-4/TRMhi_vs_lo.svg", width = 7, height = 3)
draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom", annotation_legend_side = "bottom")
dev.off()
```

#---- Cluster Specific TRM Genes ----
```{r}
levels(Tc_8$celltype)

groups <- c("CD8 TM","CD8 Tc1DM","CD8 TCTLDM")

TRM_per_cluster <- lapply(groups, function(g){

  # subset to this celltype and keep only TRMhi / TRMlo
  sub <- subset(
    Tc_8,
    subset = celltype == g & TRM_group %in% c("TRMhi", "TRMlo")
  )

  Idents(sub) <- "TRM_group"

  res_cluster <- FindMarkers(
    sub,
    ident.1 = "TRMhi",
    ident.2 = "TRMlo",
    assay = "RNA",
    logfc.thres_clusterhold = 0.25,
    min.pct = 0.25,
    test.use = "MAST",
    only.pos = FALSE
  )
  
  res_cluster$gene <- rownames(res_cluster)

  res_cluster[res_cluster$p_val_adj < 0.05, ]
})

names(TRM_per_cluster) <- groups

# Extract up/down DEG lists
up_list <- lapply(TRM_per_cluster, function(df) {
  subset(df, avg_log2FC > 0.25)$gene
})

down_list <- lapply(TRM_per_cluster, function(df) {
  subset(df, avg_log2FC < -0.25)$gene
})

common_up   <- Reduce(intersect, up_list)
common_down <- Reduce(intersect, down_list)

# helpful names
names(TRM_per_cluster) <- groups   # if groups = c("CD8_Mem", ...)

common_up

## Make sure list elements are named by cluster
groups <- c("CD8 TM","CD8 Tc1DM","CD8 TCTLDM")
names(TRM_per_cluster) <- groups

## 1. Combine into one long table
all_deg <- imap_dfr(
  TRM_per_cluster,
  ~ {
    df <- .x
    # ensure a gene column exists
    if (!"gene" %in% colnames(df)) {
      df$gene <- rownames(df)
    }
    df$cluster <- .y
    df
  }
)

## 2. Annotate direction based on avg_log2FC
all_deg <- all_deg %>%
  mutate(direction = case_when(
    avg_log2FC >  0.25 ~ "Up",
    avg_log2FC < -0.25 ~ "Down",
    TRUE               ~ "Other"
  ))

## 3. Commonly UP across all 3 clusters
common_up <- all_deg %>%
  dplyr::filter(direction == "Up") %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_distinct(cluster) == length(groups)) %>%  # pres_clusterent as Up in all 3
  ungroup()

## 4. Commonly DOWN across all 3 clusters
common_down <- all_deg %>%
  dplyr::filter(direction == "Down") %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_distinct(cluster) == length(groups)) %>%
  ungroup()

## Common UP genes, wide format
common_up_wide <- common_up %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, cluster, avg_log2FC, p_val_adj) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = cluster,
    values_from = c(avg_log2FC, p_val_adj),
    names_glue  = "{.value}_{cluster}"
  )
common_up_wide$direction <- "common_up"

## Common DOWN genes, wide format
common_down_wide <- common_down %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, cluster, avg_log2FC, p_val_adj) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = cluster,
    values_from = c(avg_log2FC, p_val_adj),
    names_glue  = "{.value}_{cluster}"
  )
common_down_wide$direction <- "common_down"
common_TRM_genes <- rbind(common_up_wide, common_down_wide)

## Genes that are Up (TRMhi) in exactly ONE cluster
unique_up <- all_deg %>%
  dplyr::filter(direction == "Up") %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_distinct(cluster) == 1) %>%  # appears as Up in only 1 cluster
  ungroup()

## Split into a named list per cluster (for quick access)
unique_up_list <- split(unique_up$gene, unique_up$cluster)

unique_up_list
# $CD8_Mem          -> genes Up only in CD8_Mem
# $CD8_Cytokine     -> genes Up only in CD8_Cytokine
# $CD8_Cytotoxic    -> genes Up only in CD8_Cytotoxic

unique_up_wide <- unique_up %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, cluster, avg_log2FC, p_val_adj) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from  = cluster,
    values_from = c(avg_log2FC, p_val_adj),
    names_glue  = "{.value}_{cluster}"
  )

unique_up_wide$direction <- "unique_up"

## Genes that are Down (TRMlo) in exactly ONE cluster
unique_down <- all_deg %>%
  dplyr::filter(direction == "Down") %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_distinct(cluster) == 1) %>%
  ungroup()

## Split into a named list per cluster
unique_down_list <- split(unique_down$gene, unique_down$cluster)

unique_down_list
# $CD8_Mem, $CD8_Cytokine, $CD8_Cytotoxic

unique_down_wide <- unique_down %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, cluster, avg_log2FC, p_val_adj) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from  = cluster,
    values_from = c(avg_log2FC, p_val_adj),
    names_glue  = "{.value}_{cluster}"
  )

unique_down_wide$direction <- "unique_down"

TRM_gene_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  common_up_wide,
  common_down_wide,
  unique_up_wide,
  unique_down_wide
)

```

#---- Venn Diagram of Signature vs. not signatue genes-General----
## Gene Overlap Between Clusters
```{r}
library(eulerr)

## Which clusters to include
groups <- c("CD8 TM","CD8 Tc1DM","CD8 TCTLDM")

## Build list of genes Up in each cluster
comparison_genes <- all_deg %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    direction == "Up",
    p_val_adj < 0.05,
    cluster %in% groups
  ) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(unique(gene)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  { setNames(.$genes, .$cluster) }

# --- Fit Euler  ---
fit <- euler(comparison_genes)

counts  <- fit$original.values
percent <- round(100 * counts / sum(counts), 1)

labels <- paste0(counts, "\n(", percent, "%)")

# --- Plot ---
plot <- plot(
  fit,
  fills = list(
    fill = c("#e86e50",  "#20A73C","#e9b321")[seq_along(comparison_genes)],
    alpha = 0.5
  ),
  labels = list(font = 2, cex = cex_base),
  quantities = list(
    labels = labels,
    font   = 2,
    cex    = cex_base
  ),
  edges = TRUE,
  main  = ""
)

cols$celltype

svglite("../docs/assets/04-Figure-4/TRM_sig_overlap.svg", width = 2.5, height = 2.5)
plot
invisible(dev.off())
knitr::include_graphics("../docs/assets/04-Figure-4/TRM_sig_overlap.svg")
```

```{r}
Core_Established <- genes_2plus

  Core_Established = Core_Established,
  Plaque_TRM       = Plaque_TRM
)

# Fit model
fit <- euler(gene_comp)

# Extract region counts

percent <- round(100 * counts / sum(counts), 1)

# Labels as "count (percent%)"

plot(

  fills = list(fill = c("#1b9e77", "#d95f02"), alpha = 0.5),
  labels = list(font = 2, cex = 1.4),

  ),
```

#----TRM hi vs low vs int HM ----
```{r}
Idents(Tc_8) <- "celltype"

sc.Avg <- AverageExpression(
  subset(
    Tc_8,
    subset = !(celltype %in% c("CD8 TN", "CD8 Tc1-CTLDM", "CD8 Proliferating")) & !(Plaque_TRM %in% "TRMint")
  ),
  assays = "RNA",
  return.seurat = TRUE,
  group.by = c("celltype", "Plaque_TRM")
)
```

```{r}
Heatmap_Genes <- c("NR4A1","NR4A2", "JUNB","EGR1", "CD69", "RGS1", "ATF4", "BHLHE40", "RGCC", "FOSB", "TFRC", "CXCR4", "VIM", "FTH1")

# Expression matrix from sc.Avg
mtx <- sc.Avg@assays$RNA@layers$scale.data |> as.data.frame()
rownames(mtx) <- rownames(sc.Avg@assays$RNA)
colnames(mtx) <- colnames(sc.Avg@assays$RNA)

mtx_sub <- mtx[rownames(mtx) %in% Heatmap_Genes, , drop = FALSE]
mtx_sub <- mtx_sub[match(Heatmap_Genes, rownames(mtx_sub)), , drop = FALSE]  # preserve gene order

# Meta for columns + FORCE celltype ordering

# 1) desired order from Seurat object
celltype_levels <- levels(Tc_8$celltype)   # or: levels(Idents(Tc_8)) if that's what you use

# 2) meta for heatmap columns
meta <- sc.Avg@meta.data[colnames(mtx_sub), , drop = FALSE]
meta$celltype <- as.character(meta$celltype)

# 3) apply Tc_8 ordering (keep only levels that actually appear in meta)
celltype_levels_use <- celltype_levels[celltype_levels %in% unique(meta$celltype)]
meta$celltype <- factor(meta$celltype, levels = celltype_levels_use)

# (optional but recommended) if anything didn't match, it becomes NA
stopifnot(!any(is.na(meta$celltype)))

# Ensure TEX labels are consistent (Other vs TX)

meta$Plaque_TRM <- as.character(meta$Plaque_TRM)
meta$Plaque_TRM <- factor(meta$Plaque_TRM, levels = c("TRMlo", "TRMhi"))


# Order columns: Other first, then TX; within each, by celltype (Tc_8 order)
ord <- with(meta, order(Plaque_TRM, celltype))
mtx_sub <- mtx_sub[, ord, drop = FALSE]
meta    <- meta[ord, , drop = FALSE]

# Colours
trm_cols <- c("TRMlo" = "lightblue", "TRMhi" = "pink")

# cols$celltype must be a NAMED vector: names are celltype labels, values are colours
celltype_cols <- cols$celltype[celltype_levels_use]
stopifnot(!any(is.na(celltype_cols)))  # catches missing names in cols$celltype

top_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  TEX      = meta$Plaque_TRM,
  celltype = meta$celltype,
  col = list(
    TEX      = trm_cols,
    celltype = celltype_cols
  ),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  annotation_height = unit(c(3, 3), "mm")
)

col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-0.5, 0, 0.5), c("black", "#21918c", "#fde725"))
heatmap_legend_params <- list(
  legend_direction = "horizontal",
  legend_position = "center",
  legend_width = unit(3, "cm"),
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  labels_rot = 0,
  title = "",
  title_gp = gpar(box_fill = "grey"),
  at = c(-1, 0, 1)
)

hm <- Heatmap(
  mtx_sub,
  height = nrow(mtx_sub) * unit(5, "mm"),
  width  = ncol(mtx_sub) * unit(5, "mm"), 
  col = col_fun,
  border = TRUE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontfamily = "Times"),
  row_names_side = "left",
  top_annotation = top_anno,
  column_split = meta$Plaque_TRM,
  cluster_column_slices = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  heatmap_legend_param = heatmap_legend_params
)

svglite::svglite("../docs/assets/04-Figure-4/TRM_by_celltype_HM.svg", width = 4, height = 5)
draw(hm, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")
dev.off()
knitr::include_graphics("../docs/assets/04-Figure-4/TRM_by_celltype_HM.svg")
```


```{r}
df_long <- subset(TRM_gene_summary, direction == "common_up") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^(avg_log2FC|p_val_adj)_"),
    names_to = c(".value", "comparison"),
    names_pattern = "(avg_log2FC|p_val_adj)_(.*)"
  )

df <- df_long %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_log2FC   = median(avg_log2FC,   na.rm = TRUE),
    p_val_adj    = median(p_val_adj,    na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    neglog10_p = -log10(p_val_adj)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number())

top_labels <- df %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% c("NR4A3", "NR4A2", "NR4A1", "JUNB", "FOS", "RGCC", "CD69", "BHLHE40", "CXCR4", "KLF6", "TFRC"))

ranked <- ggplot(df, aes(x = rank, y = avg_log2FC)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = neglog10_p), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +

  geom_point(
    data = top_labels,
    aes(color = neglog10_p, fill = neglog10_p),
    size = 4, shape = 21, stroke = 1, colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = top_labels,
    aes(label = gene, color = neglog10_p),
    size = txt_mm,
    direction = "y",
    nudge_x = 15,
    hjust = 0,
    segment.size = 0.3,
    segment.color = "black",
    box.padding = 0.2,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colours = c("pink", "orange", "red", "black"),
    name = expression(-log[10](p[adj]))
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("pink", "orange", "red", "black"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Rank",
    y = "Median Avg. Log2FC",
  title = expression(
  atop(
    "Core Plaque " * T[RM] * " Signature Genes",
    "from " * T[RM] * "-hi vs " * T[RM] * "-lo per cluster"
  ))) +
  ggpubr::theme_pubr(base_size = txt_pt) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    text = element_text(family = "Times"),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.text = element_text(size = txt_pt, colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = txt_pt, colour = "black", hjust = 0.5, vjust = -0.5),
    plot.title = element_text(size = txt_pt, hjust = 0.5, face = "plain"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 9, angle = 90),
    legend.key.height = unit(3, "mm"),
    legend.key.width  = unit(3, "mm"),
    legend.spacing.y  = unit(1, "mm"),
    legend.margin     = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
    legend.justification = "centre",
    legend.position = "bottom")

svglite::svglite("../docs/assets/04-Figure-4/Plaque_TRM_Rank.svg", width = 4, height = 4)
ranked
dev.off()
knitr::include_graphics("../docs/assets/04-Figure-4/Plaque_TRM_Rank.svg")
```
